## Summary

One paragraph: what changes, the user-visible effect, and whether it is UI-only or touches the coordinator, capture or engine.

## Why

- One motivation per bullet.

## Behaviour

What the user sees/gets: styles, defaults, what stays unchanged. Rename to "Benchmark" / "Principles" etc. only if the issue genuinely isn't user-facing behaviour.

## Implementation

Concrete files, APIs, enum cases, settings keys, constraints, and testing notes.

## Out of scope

Explicit non-goals. Cross out anything noticed along the way that should be its own issue — file it separately instead of burying it here.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Testable "done" conditions, including persistence and settings back-compat where relevant.
